name: Teixeira de Pascoaes
credit: No portrait: no public-domain photograph could be verified
bio: Joaquim Pereira Teixeira de Vasconcelos (1877–1952), who wrote as Teixeira de Pascoaes, was born at Amarante in northern Portugal, where he spent most of his life on the family estate of Pascoaes.

He founded the movement known as saudosismo, built on the Portuguese idea of saudade, and the review A Águia (1910), and became one of the leading voices of Portuguese poetry in the early twentieth century.

poems.title: Canção humilde
poems.author: Teixeira de Pascoaes
poems.collection: The Oxford Book of Portuguese Verse (1925)
poems.text:
Brisa de Abril,
todo perfume,
etéreo nume
contigo vai!

Pedrinha humilde
no chão perdida
do sol ferida
é uma estrela.

Negra ramagem
o céu tocando
vai-se pintando
de azul celeste.

Gota de orvalho
tremeluzindo,
tens o sol rindo
dentro de ti!

Humildes cousas
que ninguém olha:
raminho ou folha
ou grão de areia:

tendes o encanto
mais que divino
que o Deus Menino
achou na terra.
